import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    arr = list(s)
    res = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(arr)
    while i < n:
        length = 1
        while i + 1 < n and arr[i] == arr[i + 1]:
            length += 1
            i += 1
        if length % 2 == 0:
            res += 1
        i += 1
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
